question: A and B together can complete a piece of work in 5 days, while X and Y together can complete the same work in 20 days. The number of days A, B, X and Y together will take to complete it is:
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can complete a piece of work in 5 days.

X and Y together can complete the same work in 20 days.

**Formula Used:**

Combined Work Rate = Sum of Individual Work Rates

Work Rate = 1 / Time

Time = 1 / Combined Work Rate
